description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for the 2-D Laplacian rules central_D2x_neumann_bc + central_D2y_neumann_bc driven by problems/heat_2d_neumann_flux.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding of NX=NY together (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — no per-resolution fixture files. The manufactured solution exp(-alpha 2 pi^2 t) cos(pi x) cos(pi y) + bx x + by y is exact for the continuous PDE with constant wall fluxes bx=1, by=0.5 (derivation in the problem file); the steady ramp is discretely exact, so the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are pure spatial-discretization error from the cosine mode, expected to fall as O(h^2) with h=dx=dy.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
